name: av_unc_through_nonlinear_block
source:
{ Uncertainty propagated through an implicit 2x2 Newton block rather than an
  explicit chain — the Jacobian, not a closed form, carries the sensitivity. }
c1 = 3
UncertaintyOf(c1) = 0.15
p^2 + q^3 = 77
p/q = c1
up = UncertaintyOf(p)
uq = UncertaintyOf(q)
